0.1.40.4.source: GitHub tarball of tag v0.1.40.4 (codeload.github.com), commit 6674a0065fb96bacde33e3eb10f91a1df86f95f2
0.1.40.4.toolkit_note: Built with the distribution's own ROCm 6.2 (not the community ROCm 7.14 Docker image). gfx906 kernels are present in this ROCm's rocBLAS/MIOpen.
0.1.40.4.llama_cpp: 3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d (the commit the tag pins in third_party/ggml/VERSION.txt)
0.1.40.4.docker_image: none — engine built and run on the host
0.1.40.4.vision: off (no mmproj passed to the engine for this run)

host_patches.what: The gfx906 branch still points its CUDA-compat include path at include/strata/platform/hip_compat/, but 0.1.40.x moved those headers to include/strata/hip_compat/. Repointed the three occurrences.
host_patches.why: Without it the build uses the stale headers and fails with "use of undeclared identifier 'cudaEventBlockingSync'".

host_patches.what: Added the 24 CUDA->HIP name mappings that 0.1.39's include/strata/platform/hip_compat/strata_hip.h has and 0.1.40.x's split headers lost (cudaDeviceScheduleSpin / cudaDeviceScheduleYield / cudaDeviceScheduleBlockingSync / cudaDeviceMapHost, cudaGraphNode_t and the cudaGraphNodeType* family, cudaKernelNodeParams, cudaGraphKernelNodeGetParams, cudaMemcpyKind, cudaSetDeviceFlags, cudaEventDefault, cudaGetErrorName, cudaHostAllocWriteCombined, cudaHostRegisterDefault, cudaSharedmemCarveoutMaxShared, the three cudaStreamCapture* values and the two cudaDevAttr* bus/clock values). See patches/0.1.40.4-cuda_runtime.h.patch.
host_patches.why: gfx906 build otherwise: "use of undeclared identifier" / "unknown type name".

host_patches.what: Added the inline cudaInitDevice(dev, deviceFlags, flags) shim (verbatim from 0.1.39's strata_hip.h).
host_patches.why: remote_experts.cpp uses the CUDA 12 API; HIP has no equivalent single call.

host_patches.what: Define HIPBLAS_V2 before including <hipblas/hipblas.h>, and make cublasSetWorkspace a no-op for hipblasVersionMajor < 3.
host_patches.why: ROCm 6.2's hipBLAS 2.2 exposes hipblasGemmEx with hipDataType only when HIPBLAS_V2 is defined (0.1.39's header did this; 0.1.40.x dropped it, and hipBLAS 2.2 has no hipblasSetWorkspace).

0.1.40.4.build_environment_note: The host has libstdc++-11-dev but not libstdc++-12-dev while ROCm's clang 18 defaults to GCC 12; without --gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/11 the C++ compiler check fails ("fatal error: 'cmath' file not found", then "unable to find library -lstdc++").
0.1.40.4.notes: One dependency patch in the pinned llama.cpp: ggml/src/ggml-cuda/vendors/hip.h guards the __hip_fp8_e4m3 typedef with HIP_VERSION >= 60300000 (ROCm 6.2 ships only the fp8 storage helpers). The engine's own sources were not otherwise modified.
